title: Bulk Price Changes
statement: A store has n products, all priced 0 at first. Each change [l, r, v] adds v (which may be negative) to the price of every product from l to r, both included. Return the final prices after all changes.

answerKey.pattern: Difference array, then one prefix sum
keyPoints: diff[l] += v and diff[r + 1] −= v for each change
One prefix sum over diff gives the final prices
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Apply each change to every product in its range: O(m · n)

hints: Applying a change to every product in its range is slow when ranges are long. What marks only where a change starts and stops?
Record +v where a range starts and −v just after it ends.
After all changes, a running total of those marks is each product's price.
